gloss: place in the tribe of Zebulun
definition: חַנָּתֹן proper name, of a location place in the tribe of Zebulun Josh 19:14 ᵐ5 Αμωθ , Αενναθωθ , ᵐ5 L Αναθωθ ; site unknown; according to Conder = Talm, Caphar Hanania ( Nbr Geogr. 176. 226 ) on the border of Upper and Lower Galilee, modern Kefr' Anân, Survey WP i. 205, 207 .
